comment: Johnson is great - he is effortlessly brilliant. A real genius at Urban Economics and is very personable and willing to help. The class isn't tremendously difficult but you will learn a lot. Great professor!
Chill guy and chill class. Will cover everything and is easily accessible outside of class.

Johnson is the man. Having taken stats before has helped a lot, because he is unclear at times,  but he's insanely accessible and willing to work with you. Daily participation is necessary but he gives everyone expo "squiggles" on their paper for it each day so it's not hard. Also he gives an insane amount of extra credit. Take him, he's so chill!

Johnson clearly knows a lot about statistics, but his personality is so chill that he'll glaze over things and put off assigning homework for months. The class doesn't require much work which is great, and he's a funny guy, but it's best to take him if you already have experience with statistics, otherwise you'll probably be lost.
